title: New Jersey Stamp Day
subtitle: The Saturday of a December work week in NYC: one clockwise loop from Newark for Edison, Paterson Great Falls, the Delaware Water Gap and Morristown.

days.label: Arrival
days.title: Fly to Newark
days.meta: No stamps · travel, then a work week
days.html:
✈︎

United UA1808 · SFO → EWR

Departs 2:00 PM, lands 10:29 PM. Seat 32C · confirmation PWCPWM. Uber into Manhattan.

Mon–Fri is the work week in NYC. Before Friday, check the NWS forecast and call Paterson (973-523-0370) to confirm the stamp office is open Saturday.

Pack the Mid-Atlantic pages of your passport. All four stamps go in the New Jersey and Pennsylvania sections.

days.label: Stamp day
days.title: The New Jersey loop
days.sub: EWR → West Orange → Paterson → Delaware Water Gap → Morristown → EWR
days.cut: Edison, Kittatinny Point and Jockey Hollow all close at 4 PM. Jockey Hollow has the least buffer, so shorten lunch if you're running late. If snow or ice is forecast, drop Kittatinny Point and keep the three close stops.

days.label: Home
days.title: Fly home
days.cut: Return the rental by ~9:45 AM for the 11:55 AM flight.

stops.name: Pick up the rental car
stops.note: Check out of the Manhattan hotel, Uber to Newark Airport and collect the car (Costco Travel booking).

stops.name: Thomas Edison NHP
stops.where: Laboratory Complex Visitor Center (Building 1). Everyone starts here.
stops.hrs: Thu–Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM. America the Beautiful pass covers the fee.
stops.acc: The Main Laboratory has an elevator between all three floors.
stops.warn: Glenmont, the Edison home, is closed until further notice. The lab and stamp are open.
stops.about: Edison's 1887 West Orange lab, where the motion picture camera, improved phonographs and the alkaline storage battery came out.

stops.name: Paterson Great Falls NHP
stops.where: Administrative office at 72 McBride Ave Ext. There's no visitor center. Park in the Great Falls Overlook lot.
stops.hrs: Rangers on site 9:00 AM–4:30 PM daily. Saturday office hours not confirmed online.
stops.warn: Call 973-523-0370 the week before to confirm the office is open Saturday.
stops.acc: The Overlook Park views of the falls are close to the lot. Portable toilets only.
stops.about: The 77-foot Great Falls of the Passaic powered Hamilton's planned industrial city. Grab lunch nearby before heading west on I-80.

stops.name: Delaware Water Gap NRA
stops.addr: Kittatinny Point Visitor Center, Columbia, NJ
stops.via: I-80 West all the way to Exit 1.
stops.where: Kittatinny Point Visitor Center. The stamp reads "Delaware Water Gap NRA · Kittatinny Point, NJ."
stops.hrs: Saturdays 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, closed Mon–Fri (NPS app).
stops.ok: The Bushkill (PA) headquarters desk is weekdays only in winter, so this is the Saturday stamp.
stops.about: Where the Delaware River cuts through Kittatinny Ridge, with Mount Tammany on the New Jersey side. The farthest point of the day.

stops.name: Morristown NHP
stops.hrs: Thu–Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM. The winter closure starts Jan 4, 2027.
stops.warn: Closes at 4 PM, about 70 minutes after you arrive.
stops.about: The Continental Army's encampment in the brutal winter of 1779–80. Washington's Headquarters Museum in town is a backup stamp location.

stops.name: an EWR-area hotel
stops.note: Not booked yet. Close to the airport for tomorrow's 11:55 AM flight.

stops.title: Newark → home
stops.note: Return the rental, then United UA1914 at 11:55 AM, landing SFO 3:24 PM. Seat 37F.
